/////////////////////privacyPolicy/////////////////////////////////// Your Privacy Matters We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data. Last updated: January 2026
Information We Collect We collect only the information you provide directly through the app, such as notes, tasks, and voice recordings. We do not collect personal identification information without your explicit consent.
Data Storage All your notes and tasks are stored locally on your device. We do not upload your data to external servers unless you explicitly choose to enable cloud sync features.
AI Features When you use AI features like rephrasing or task extraction, your text is sent to our AI provider (Groq) for processing. This data is not stored permanently and is used only to generate the response. We recommend not including sensitive personal information in AI-processed content.
Microphone Access The app requests microphone access only when you initiate a voice recording. Recordings are saved locally on your device and are never uploaded without your knowledge. You can revoke microphone permission at any time from your device settings.
Photos and Media The app requests access to your photos and media only when you choose to attach an image to a note. Selected images are copied to the app\'s private storage on your device. We do not access or scan your gallery without your action.
Data Sharing We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal data to third parties. The only exception is when required by law or to protect the rights and safety of users. AI processing is done through Groq\'s API under their privacy policy.
Data Security We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. Your data is stored in the app\'s private directory, inaccessible to other apps. We regularly review our security practices to ensure your information remains safe.
Children\'s Privacy Our app is not directed to children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.
Changes to This Policy We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the date at the top of this policy. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
